textRuns.value: Insight 1: Return rates differ ~2x by category (furniture_decor 4.7%, bed_bath_table 4.4% vs. cool_stuff 2.5%). This chart counts any purchase in the category; the model data (first-order category, return on day 31-180) shows a stronger gap: sports_leisure 2.08% vs. auto 0.67% (~3x).
Insight 2: 30,469 current customers have not returned yet; Group A (1,523) is the first list for a second-purchase offer, followed by Group B (4,570).
Insight 3: The biggest levers are operational - contact customers in the first 30 days after delivery and make sure their first order arrives on time.
